name: Global Ping & Latency Matrix
purpose: Measures multi-continent round-trip latency, packet loss, and jitter using distributed global probes.
problemSolved: Diagnoses intercontinental latency bottlenecks, packet drops, and Anycast routing anomalies from true external vantage points.

name: Multi-Vantage DNS Resolver & Propagation
purpose: Queries authoritative and recursive DNS resolvers worldwide to verify records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT) and detect propagation lag.
problemSolved: Identifies split-horizon DNS misconfigurations, slow global propagation after record updates, and regional DNS poisoning.

name: HTTP/HTTPS Edge Health & Header Inspector
purpose: Executes HTTP HEAD/GET requests from distributed nodes to measure Time-to-First-Byte (TTFB) and TLS handshake overhead.
problemSolved: Pinpoints edge server caching issues, CDN regional degradation, and misconfigured TLS termination proxies.

name: Traceroute & Autonomous Path Visualizer
purpose: Traces Layer-3 IP packet routing hops across international internet exchange points (IXPs) and transit providers.
problemSolved: Detects sub-optimal routing hops, transatlantic latency surges, and peering congestion points.

name: Authoritative ASN & BGP Prefix Registry
purpose: Queries RIPE NCC authoritative databases to identify Autonomous System owners, BGP announced prefixes, and RIR allocations.
problemSolved: Verifies network ownership, detects BGP prefix hijacking risks, and inspects global route collector visibility.

name: IPv4 Subnet & Boundary Analyzer
purpose: Calculates network boundaries, wildcard masks, and usable host allocations with visual binary octet representation.
problemSolved: Eliminates calculation errors in VLSM (Variable Length Subnet Masking), IP planning, and CIDR block allocation.

name: IPv6 128-Bit BigInt Block Allocator
purpose: Calculates 128-bit IPv6 address spaces, RFC 5952 zero-compression, full expansion, and /64 subnet counts.
problemSolved: Solves complex 128-bit hexadecimal prefix calculations and classifies address scopes (GUA, ULA, Link-Local).

name: NIST SP 800-63B Secret & Key Generator
purpose: Generates cryptographically secure API tokens, pre-shared keys, and passwords with entropy calculation per NIST guidelines.
problemSolved: Prevents weak credentials and PRNG predictability by enforcing cryptographically random byte generation.
